column1: # Hebrew (he) — UNANIMOUS 3-REFEREE consensus gold: vocalized-form <TAB> canonical Modern-Israeli IPA.
# Built from words where THREE INDEPENDENT referees agree after canonicalization (strip stress/tie, unwrap
# Wiktionary optional-parens): Wiktionary a=IL (lexicographic) + Phonikud (rule-FST, CC-BY) + ReNikud
